items.question: How many non-cancelled invoices are still unpaid?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS UnpaidInvoiceCount
FROM IV AS i
LEFT JOIN ARPaymentKnockOff AS ko
    ON ko.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
LEFT JOIN ARPayment AS p
    ON p.DocKey = ko.PaymentDocKey
   AND p.Cancelled = 'F'
WHERE i.Cancelled = 'F'
GROUP BY i.DocKey
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.DocKey IS NOT NULL THEN ko.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) < i.TotalIncTax;

B1.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unpaid_invoice_count
FROM IV AS i
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ko.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(ko.Amount) AS paid_amount
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff AS ko
    INNER JOIN ARPayment AS p
        ON p.DocKey = ko.PaymentDocKey
       AND p.Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY ko.InvoiceDocKey
) AS payments
    ON payments.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
WHERE i.Cancelled = 'F'
  AND COALESCE(payments.paid_amount, 0) < i.TotalIncTax;

B2.sql:
WITH AppliedPayments AS (
    SELECT
        pko.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(pko.Amount) AS PaidAmount
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff AS pko
    JOIN ARPayment AS p
        ON p.DocKey = pko.PaymentDocKey
       AND p.Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY pko.InvoiceDocKey
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS UnpaidInvoiceCount
FROM IV AS i
LEFT JOIN AppliedPayments AS ap
    ON ap.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
WHERE i.Cancelled = 'F'
  AND COALESCE(ap.PaidAmount, 0) < i.TotalIncTax;

B3.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unpaid_invoice_count
FROM IV AS i
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ko.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(ko.Amount) AS paid_amount
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff AS ko
    INNER JOIN ARPayment AS p
        ON p.DocKey = ko.PaymentDocKey
       AND p.Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY ko.InvoiceDocKey
) AS payments
    ON payments.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
WHERE i.Cancelled = 'F'
  AND COALESCE(payments.paid_amount, 0) < i.TotalIncTax;

items.question: Which customer owes us the most on unpaid, non-cancelled invoices?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
WITH invoice_totals AS (
    SELECT
        iv.DocKey,
        iv.DebtorCode,
        iv.TotalIncTax
    FROM IV AS iv
    WHERE iv.Cancelled = 'F'
),
credit_notes AS (
    SELECT
        cn.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(cn.TotalIncTax) AS CreditNoteTotal
    FROM CN AS cn
    WHERE cn.Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY cn.InvoiceDocKey
),
payments AS (
    SELECT
        ko.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(ko.Amount) AS PaymentTotal
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff AS ko
    JOIN ARPayment AS p
        ON p.DocKey = ko.PaymentDocKey
       AND p.Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY ko.InvoiceDocKey
)
SELECT
    d.AccNo AS DebtorCode,
    d.CompanyName,
    SUM(
        it.TotalIncTax
        - COALESCE(cn.CreditNoteTotal, 0)
        - COALESCE(p.PaymentTotal, 0)
    ) AS OutstandingAmount
FROM invoice_totals AS it
JOIN Debtor AS d
    ON d.AccNo = it.DebtorCode
LEFT JOIN credit_notes AS cn
    ON cn.InvoiceDocKey = it.DocKey
LEFT JOIN payments AS p
    ON p.InvoiceDocKey = it.DocKey
GROUP BY d.AccNo, d.CompanyName
HAVING OutstandingAmount > 0
ORDER BY OutstandingAmount DESC
LIMIT 1;

B1.sql:
WITH invoice_totals AS (
    SELECT
        iv.DocKey,
        iv.DebtorCode,
        iv.TotalIncTax
    FROM IV AS iv
    WHERE iv.Cancelled = 'F'

credit_notes AS (
    SELECT
        cn.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(cn.TotalIncTax) AS CreditNoteTotal
    FROM CN AS cn
    WHERE cn.Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY cn.InvoiceDocKey
),
payments AS (
    SELECT
        ko.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(ko.Amount) AS PaymentTotal
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff AS ko
    JOIN ARPayment AS p
        ON p.DocKey = ko.PaymentDocKey
       AND p.Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY ko.InvoiceDocKey
)
SELECT
    d.AccNo AS DebtorCode,
    d.CompanyName,
    SUM(
        it.TotalIncTax
        - COALESCE(cn.CreditNoteTotal, 0)
        - COALESCE(p.PaymentTotal, 0)
    ) AS OutstandingAmount
FROM invoice_totals AS it
JOIN Debtor AS d
    ON d.AccNo = it.DebtorCode
LEFT JOIN credit_notes AS cn
    ON cn.InvoiceDocKey = it.DocKey
LEFT JOIN payments AS p
    ON p.InvoiceDocKey = it.DocKey
GROUP BY d.AccNo, d.CompanyName
HAVING OutstandingAmount > 0
ORDER BY OutstandingAmount DESC
LIMIT 1;

B2.sql:
WITH PaymentTotals AS (
    SELECT
        pko.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(pko.Amount) AS PaidAmount
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff AS pko
    JOIN ARPayment AS p
        ON p.DocKey = pko.PaymentDocKey
       AND p.Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY pko.InvoiceDocKey
),
CreditNoteTotals AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(TotalIncTax) AS CreditNoteAmount
    FROM CN
    WHERE Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY InvoiceDocKey
),
InvoiceBalances AS (
    SELECT
        i.DebtorCode,
        i.DocKey,
        i.TotalIncTax
            - COALESCE(pt.PaidAmount, 0)
            - COALESCE(cnt.CreditNoteAmount, 0) AS OutstandingAmount
    FROM IV AS i
    LEFT JOIN PaymentTotals AS pt
        ON pt.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
    LEFT JOIN CreditNoteTotals AS cnt
        ON cnt.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
    WHERE i.Cancelled = 'F'
)
SELECT
    ib.DebtorCode,
    d.CompanyName,
    SUM(ib.OutstandingAmount) AS AmountOwed,
    COUNT(*) AS UnpaidInvoiceCount
FROM InvoiceBalances AS ib
LEFT JOIN Debtor AS d
    ON d.AccNo = ib.DebtorCode
WHERE ib.OutstandingAmount > 0
GROUP BY ib.DebtorCode, d.CompanyName
ORDER BY AmountOwed DESC
LIMIT 1;

items.author: team

B0.sql:
WITH latest_invoice AS (
    SELECT MAX(DocDate) AS LatestInvoiceDate
    FROM IV
    WHERE COALESCE(Cancelled, 'F') <> 'T'
),
paid AS (
    SELECT
        k.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(k.Amount) AS PaidAmount
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff AS k
    LEFT JOIN ARPayment AS p
        ON p.DocKey = k.PaymentDocKey
    WHERE COALESCE(p.Cancelled, 'F') <> 'T'
    GROUP BY k.InvoiceDocKey
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.DebtorCode) AS CustomerCount
FROM IV AS i
CROSS JOIN latest_invoice AS l
LEFT JOIN paid AS p
    ON p.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
WHERE COALESCE(i.Cancelled, 'F') <> 'T'
  AND i.DueDate IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(l.LatestInvoiceDate) - julianday(i.DueDate) > 90
  AND COALESCE(p.PaidAmount, 0) < i.TotalIncTax;
